sub_sections.title: Multi-mission Campaign Achievements
sub_sections.description_text:
You Had it Coming
Halo 4: Beat the par score on every Halo 4 level.

Easy As One Two Three
Halo 4: Beat the par time on all Halo 4 levels.

[table]
[tr]
[th]
Terminus
Halo 4: Activate all Halo 4 Terminals.

[previewyoutube=g93_ZW0pb_c;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*]Videos also posted in each mission section!
[/list]
[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[table]
[tr]
[th]
Chest of Gold
Halo 4: Complete a Halo 4 playlist.

Devotee
Halo 4: Complete three Halo 4 playlists.
[list]
[*]Go to Campaign > Halo 4 > Playlist
[/list]
[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[table]
[tr]
[th]
The Legend of 117
Halo 4: Complete every level of the game on Legendary difficulty.

I Need a Hero
Halo 4: Complete every level of the game on Heroic difficulty.

Wake Up, John
Halo 4: Complete every level of the game on Normal difficulty.

Librarian's Gift
Halo 4: Complete every level of the game on Easy difficulty.
[list]
[*]Any difficulty you choose you will always get the easier difficulty achievement(s) below it.
[/list]
[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

You're Joking
Halo 4: Complete all Halo 4 Legendary campaign missions in under 3 hours.

Lone Wolf Legend
Halo 4: Complete every level of the game on Legendary difficulty, by yourself.

[table]
[tr]
[th]
Naked Tyrant
Halo 4: Complete the Halo 4 LASO Campaign playlist.
[list]
[*] Make sure you select the LASO Playlist in the Campaign area instead of starting the missions on LASO.
[*] If you're Solo you can Save/Quit when you die > Playlist > Resume > Start > Start  to resume last checkpoint instead of starting all over.
[*] LASO videos posted to each section that will help you
[*] Go into a custom game with a Sniper and put some scotch tape marked with your own personal artificial crosshair. If you have classic crosshairs either put down another piece of tape or change the settings so when you zoom in and out your artificial crosshair is still aiming at the same spot on your screen.
[*] The plasma pistol will be your best friend due to the Tilt skull. It will deplete Elite's shields faster than normal, allowing for a quick head-shot followup.
[/list]
[/th]
[/tr]
[/table] 

LAASO (They don't have blind on)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u-pxeMdFbGw
